before_agent_start: Negotiated before_prompt_state_v1; before_prompt payload {prompt,system_prompt}. Ordered callbacks see event.systemPrompt and return {systemPrompt}; hook response system_prompt is a per-run replacement including empty string, never additive context. configure declares capabilities.system_prompt. 256KiB/noNUL; message/images transformations remain explicit refusals. Native apply/transaction qualification is parent-owned.
child_facade: Runtime installs children.mjs, negotiates CHILD_FEATURES and retains CHILD_METHODS with original resource_owner; owner retirement/shutdown retire child facades. coding-agent shim reexports child-sdk. No Pi agent/provider fallback; child native end-to-end qualification is separate.

provider_context.hook: context -> provider_context; requires session_entries and actual top-level session_leaf matching preparation owner/head
provider_context.output: ordinary envelope plus provider_context:{messages:<canonical>,system:<unchanged native string|null>} when changed; ordered awaited Pi handlers support replacement and in-place edits
provider_context.limits: Text/tool/custom-message profile only; media, opaque continuation, unsupported roles and native facts not supplied explicitly refuse. Never fabricate timestamps, usage, historical provider identity or entry IDs. Native budgets/role validation remain authoritative.

synchronous_append.api: appendEntry is synchronous void; independent transport worker and one bounded shared reply cell, never an optimistic Promise
synchronous_append.authority: Hook append requires actual host session_leaf {grant_id,activation_epoch,operation_id,owner,expected_head}; exact parent and owner echoed; consume before submission, advance only with validated known successor
synchronous_append.receipt: session/append_entry -> {entry_id,head,successor}; head names the committed entry. Existing active command/tool legacy service may reply {entry_id}. No local fake ACK, retry or persistence inference
synchronous_append.limits: 16KiB encoded entry envelope, depth16/nodes256/key256/type128. Private string values may contain LF/CR/TAB only. After-claim cancellation waits for known outcome; lost/malformed receipt terminalizes unknown
synchronous_append.mirrors: Lazy native Entry translation from host snapshots; initialize.extension.name selects own private namespace. Real IDs/parents/timestamps preserved; native markers remain octet_native. Missing facts stay missing.

provider_pipeline.feature: pipeline_hooks_v1; requires actual API0.4 native consumer
provider_pipeline.phases: before_provider_request -> {provider_payload}; before_provider_headers in-place changes -> {provider_headers:<patch including null deletions>}; after_provider_response at actual header arrival -> {}
provider_pipeline.privacy: Encoded bodies/headers and callback exception text are not emitted in ordinary diagnostics. Native owns reserved header validation/auth/signing and attempt cancellation.

session_operations.hooks: session_before_compact/session_compact/session_before_tree/session_tree require session_entries and actual bound native leaf
session_operations.gaps: No advisory-notification veto. Native missing Pi willRetry/counts/settings/fileOps/tree-summary preparation explicitly refuse. Unsupported compaction replacement details/counts/usage are not dropped.

wait_for_idle: Live command only; negotiated session_control_v1; session/wait_for_idle with actual parent/resource_owner waits for {session_id} matching current native session. No settled-parent exception or hook-self-wait.
configure: node configure.mjs --reviewed --output /absolute/extensions/octet-pi-compat <entry.ts>...; canonical Node + absolute runner; no activation/trust/HOME edits

command_completions.registration: Require negotiated autocomplete only when a command declares getArgumentCompletions. After the initialize response, send process-owned ui/autocomplete/register {revision:1}; require {accepted:true}. No invented parent/session owner.
command_completions.request: ui/autocomplete/complete {text,cursor,revision}; text <=262144 UTF-8 bytes, cursor at a byte boundary, safe nonnegative revision. Inspect current line, trim only before slash, preserve entire raw argument prefix after first space, with Pi1.0 attachment-token precedence.
command_completions.response: Await the real sync/async factory callback. Return {prefix,items:[{value,label,description?}]}; <=32 items, <=1024 UTF-8 bytes per plain-text field. Null/empty/non-array Pi results or unclaimed input return {prefix:'',items:[]}. Errors remain errors; no coercion or truncation.
command_completions.fences: Each request retains its own snapshot and RPC ID; no global revision high-water mark. Cancellation settles promptly without publishing late callback results. Native code must enforce full text/cursor/revision/focus/provider-owner identity before display/application and empty-result chain/path fallback.
command_completions.limits: Explicitly refuse quote consumption after cursor, cursor-inside-quoted-directory edits, control-containing prefixes/items, extra fields and oversized results. Current wire is suffix-only; no proposed item-range fields are emitted. No filesystem completion or automatic/forced-file UI parity claim.
command_completions.qualification: Actual factory/raw-process and source-hash-verified Pi1.0 differential tests, not native completion UI or fallback qualification. Unchanged pinned commands.ts callback executes.

tool_prompt_metadata.feature: tool_prompt_metadata_v1; API0.4 only; required only by tools declaring either field, including explicit empty values
tool_prompt_metadata.mapping: promptSnippet -> prompt_snippet, promptGuidelines -> prompt_guidelines in tool catalog only; preserve values for native Pi projection trimming, never add manifest keys
tool_prompt_metadata.bounds: <=1024 UTF-8 bytes per string, <=16 guidelines; C0/C1 forbidden except newline/tab. Empty strings/arrays allowed. Native host counts fields in aggregate catalog budget.
tool_prompt_metadata.qualification: Adapter raw-process catalog/negotiation/boundary/execution tests only; effective native prompt projection needs independent qualification. No new authority or canonical0.3 change.

resource_discovery.activation: Integrated adapter contract; native resource_paths_v1 stays default-off outside a complete real App startup/reload/retirement consumer. Mapping or empty CLM results do not qualify activation.
resource_discovery.registration: Map resources_discover to the same named API0.4 hook; declaring it requires negotiated resource_paths_v1. Configure captures the hook without executing callbacks; initialize retains exact reviewed catalog and manifest equality.
resource_discovery.request: hook/run {hook:'resources_discover',payload:{cwd,reason:'startup'|'reload'},context:{resource_owner,...}}. Native supplies an absolute cwd and complete current owner after actual session_start. No payload.binding fallback, invented owner or inferred reload reason.
resource_discovery.response: Only {resource_paths:{skill_paths,prompt_paths,theme_paths}}. Snapshot factory/registration order, await callbacks through the existing hook queue, validate optional skillPaths/promptPaths/themePaths string arrays and merge without deduplication. Undefined is empty; null/sparse/malformed/unknown fields fail, never silently strip transformations.
resource_discovery.normalization: Pinned Pi1.0 trim/home/file-URL/lexical cwd resolution (including blank path -> cwd), not factory/manifest directory or realpath. Preserve internal Unicode spaces and @. Reject synthetic paths; <=4096 UTF-8 bytes per raw/normalized path and no controls after trim/decoding; <=64 paths and <=65536 normalized bytes across all fields/handlers before deduplication.
resource_discovery.fences: Require current full native owner before dispatch, between callbacks and after tracked reverse operations. Cancellation races the queue/callback/flush; retirement aborts only active discovery controllers. Preserve existing editor87 lifetime rules exactly; no late reply, timeout replay or fabricated host ACK.
resource_discovery.errors: Diagnose ordinary callback exceptions with contributing factory provenance and continue like Pi. Coded adapter/native refusals and returned-value validation errors fail the request. Diagnostics are separate notifications/stderr, never generic hook result fields.
resource_discovery.native_responsibilities: Admission/trust/no-follow reads, deadline, owner/process generation fences, real loader consumption, catalog/Agent/shell/theme publication and withdrawal on reload/retirement. Native later-wins precedence differs from Pi; native JSON format support and qualification are separate. No full resource or CLM compatibility claim.
resource_discovery.qualification: Node actual-factory subprocess tests and source-hash-verified Pi1.0 normalization only. Native consumer activation and all App/frontend tests remain integration gates.

params.host: ExtensionHostState, including model_view; optional truthful context_usage/session_entries/using_oauth/composer_text/git_branch/active_tools snapshots

context_updated.notes: Negotiated remote_ui only. Unowned/foreign/stale updates cannot mutate retained session contexts. Ordinary hook/run context is {workspace,resource_owner,host}; payload.binding supplies the same complete triple on session hooks. Missing session entries/OAuth/composer snapshots explicitly unsupported, never invented empty data. model_view maps snake_case capacity/rate units to Pi camelCase.

editor_state: Negotiate editor_handoff; ui/editor-state {text,revision,focused} updates the active owner's native composer mirror only without a custom editor. Unfenced snapshots and command-time composer/get never overwrite an active custom draft or acknowledge its input.

editor_checkpoint.open: editor ui/open must return editor_mount_id; absence explicitly refuses the custom editor, with no legacy unfenced fallback
editor_checkpoint.input: editor ui/key includes editor_input {mount_id,input_revision}; revisions start at 1 and must be consecutive for this mount
editor_checkpoint.initial_input: Queue at most128 bounded normalized/fenced events while open/factory/composer seed initialization is pending. Validate actual open mount identity before delivery, seed first, then dispatch each once in order. First component frame awaits its captured checkpoint tail. Overflow/missing/foreign/gapped fences refuse explicitly. Close/rescue discards undispatched events; no raw-key/native recovery replay.
editor_checkpoint.write: composer/set {text,editor_checkpoint:{surface_id,mount_id,input_revision,checkpoint_revision}} plus ordinary full resource_owner and retained parent_request_id; no nested caller-chosen owner
editor_checkpoint.ack: host replies {input_revision,checkpoint_revision} only after actual commit; adapter requires both to match the captured checkpoint
editor_checkpoint.ordering: Input handlers suppress intermediate onChange checkpoints and checkpoint final getText after successful synchronous completion, including no-op/release. Async edits use the last completed input revision and a new checkpoint revision. Submission follows the final checkpoint.
editor_checkpoint.frames: Capture lines, geometry and exact checkpoint tail together, await that barrier before publishing; never render newer text after waiting on an older tail. One scheduled frame plus one dirty flag bounds pending render work.
editor_checkpoint.setters: Same-owner setEditorText/pasteToEditor use the active component across factories and await a fenced checkpoint; paste requires insertTextAtCursor. Native-only composer/set/insert behavior is unchanged.
editor_checkpoint.retained_lifetime: Only actual composer/set editor checkpoints from the mounted editor store, with matching surface/mount identity and full live owner, have independent local child lifetime while the origin is live. Other reverse calls retain their live-parent attachment; generic composer/set without checkpoint still cancels on normal parent settlement. The real numeric opening parent_request_id, full resource_owner and original AbortSignal remain unchanged. True origin/child cancellation still aborts, including retained surface cancellation after reply. Nonretained methods require matching live request identity. Native admission needs the corresponding narrow checkpoint exception and unchanged authority/cancellation fences.
editor_checkpoint.retirement: Voluntary clear/replacement drains accepted ordered writes. Observed close/rescue/shutdown stops input immediately and prevents queued work/frames from publishing; in-flight requests retain the retired mount ID for native rejection. Host restoration notices must remain truthful about unacknowledged inputs.
editor_checkpoint.qualification: Synthetic process tests only until current-source native integration/build and PTY qualification. Historical burst-rescue failure evidence remains red.

custom_commands: Only fullscreen custom() detaches command/execute after first frame. Original JS handler/custom() result promise remain live until actual done(result), ui/closed, cancellation, owner replacement or shutdown. Background calls echo opening numeric parent + complete owner. Header/footer/widget setters await all openings before their request settles.
geometry: ui/open returns positive columns/rows for placement; ui/resize uses surface_id with columns/rows; remote components never start or write a terminal

mouse.open: ui/open optional mouse_capture:true only for exact reviewed 1000/1002/1006 capture intent
mouse.event: ui/mouse {surface_id,kind:press|release|drag|move|wheel,button:left|middle|right|none,x,y,modifiers,wheel_delta}; zero-based coordinates rebuilt as one-based SGR; positive wheel delta means down
mouse.notes: Raw mouse-mode stdout writes are never forwarded. Other direct terminal control writes fail. SGR cannot represent super modifier, so that impossible conversion is explicit invalid_request. Rust owns capture/restoration.

acceptance: Synthetic-host subprocess tests cover unchanged Doom WASM+WAD, installed powerline-footer 0.5.4, original Ben Vinegar /draw and original rainbow CustomEditor; Doom/footer also coexist in one Node process. Actual Rust terminal painting/PTY remains parent-owned.
